fluentBadgeReference.comparisonKind: Fluent 2 Badge guidance + pinned Web Components 3.1.3 API census + pinned React v9.74.10 semantic triage; platform reduced-motion guidance for a Bluent-only animation extension; not 1:1 parity acceptance

interpretation.fluentBadge: A compact status/description indicator; not focusable by default. Icon-only use needs an accessible label; parent naming should convey badge meaning when associated.
interpretation.fluentCounterBadge: A distinct upstream component concept; the Bluent free-text +99 fixture does not establish numeric count, zero-display, overflow, or announcement parity.
interpretation.pinnedWebComponents313: The pinned crosswalk inventories separate fluent-badge and fluent-counter-badge elements; exact per-property/value comparison remains open.
interpretation.reducedMotion: MDN defines reduce as a user preference to remove, reduce, or replace non-essential motion. The observed infinite shadow pulse is a Bluent extension; no Fluent Badge-specific animation policy is inferred.
